title: 第240章 我心难安第239章 南冥王二
content_zh:
然而涉及永恒，以姜峰目前的修为，还无法完全看透其中的因果。
只是【姜黎】的出现，让他心中有了诸多的猜测。
十狱，九幽，幽灵界。
小灵界，灵界，魔界。
人间……
魔尊也曾说过，在远古时期，人间乃是诸天万界的核心，诸天生灵皆可穿过两界通道，降临人间。
故而魔界与人间之间，存在一条空间通道，位置落于长安。
小灵界的前身是灵界，与人间之间的空间通道，位置在周国的灵谷。
幽冥界与人间之间，也有青铜鬼门，位置落于江州。
照此推测。
这些世界距离人间并不遥远。
此外。
九幽与小灵界之间，也存在着空间通道。
虽说通道已经被毁，但起码证明，幽灵界与小灵界也存在关联。
姜峰面露沉思，总觉得这当中也存在着某种看不透的因果。
这时，南冥王接着开口说道：“虽然我并不是从前那个姜黎，但从某种意义上来说，我还是姜黎，也是你的生父。”
他眸光深深的看着姜峰：“你能修行到这个境界，属实让我感到意外，但血缘上的关系，这是斩也斩不断的，无论你走到哪一步，皆是如此。”
姜峰神情淡定：“你不会以为，一个我从来都没见过的人，凭借这点血缘关系，便能左右我的思想吧？”
“更何况，你还不是他。”
南冥王笑了笑：“倒也不是要左右你的思想，或是操控你的人生，你我都知道这是不可能的事情。”

“只是，如果你能念及这点血脉亲情的话，我希望……”
姜峰竖掌截话，打断道：“在此之前，我只想先弄清楚一件事。”
南冥王示意道：“请讲。”
姜峰眸光冷肃的盯着他：“我娘，是否也如你这般？”
南冥王沉吟片刻，摇了摇头，道：“我不知道。当我重新苏醒的时候，便已经在尸蛮国了。”
“过往的事情，我也仅有一些记忆存在，但并不完整。”
“我也试过，去打探过往的事情，想过重返人间，可在我试图打听的时候，我收到了严重的警告。”
南冥王有些遗憾的叹息道：“我无法回去。”
姜峰又问：“那你还当自己是人族吗？”
南冥王点了点头：“当然，这也是改变不了的事实。”
姜峰沉默。
尽管南冥王的神魂与肉身并非完全契合，但神魂的样貌与肉身一致，足以确定他与这具身体，有着千丝万缕的关系。
这是一道重生的神魂！
换句话来说，他死去的生父重生了，只是失去了一部分记忆。
老实说，他到现在还是有些难以接受。
他的生父姜黎，竟然是以这样的方式，出现在他面前。
而且，眼前这个人，到底还能不能算是姜黎呢？
姜峰自己也说不清。
哪怕他在言语上否认，可有些事情，并不能就此改变。
content_en:
However, when it comes to eternity, with Jiang Feng's current level of cultivation, he still cannot fully understand the cause and effect.
It was just the appearance of [Jiang Li] that made him have a lot of guesses.
Ten Hells, Nine Netherworlds, and the Ghost Realm.
Small spirit world, spirit world, demon world.
Human world...
The Demon Lord once said that in ancient times, the human world was the core of all heavens and worlds, and all living beings could pass through the passage between the two worlds and descend to the human world.
Therefore, there is a spatial passage between the demon world and the human world, located in Chang'an.
The predecessor of the Little Spirit World was the Spirit World, the space passage between the world and the human world. It was located in the Spiritual Valley of Zhou State.
There is also a bronze ghost gate between the underworld and the human world, located in Jiangzhou.
According to this assumption.
These worlds are not far away from the human world.
also.
There is also a space channel between Jiuyou and the Small Spirit Realm.
Although the passage has been destroyed, it at least proves that the ghost world and the small spirit world are also related.
Jiang Feng looked thoughtful, always feeling that there was some kind of invisible cause and effect in this.
At this time, Nan Pluto continued and said: "Although I am not the same Jiang Li as before, in a sense, I am still Jiang Li and your biological father."
He looked deeply at Jiang Feng: "It really surprises me that you can cultivate to this level, but the blood relationship is something that can never be cut off. No matter where you go, it is the same."
Jiang Feng looked calm: "You don't think that a person I have never met can influence my thoughts based on this blood relationship, do you?"
"What's more, you are not him."
Nan Pluto smiled: "It's not that I want to influence your thoughts or control your life. You and I both know this is impossible."
"It's just that if you can think of this blood relationship, I hope..."
Jiang Feng raised his palm to cut off the conversation and interrupted: "Before that, I just want to clarify one thing first."
Nan Ping Wang signaled: "Please speak."
Jiang Feng stared at him with cold eyes: "My mother, is she like you?"
Nan Ping Wang pondered for a moment, shook his head, and said: "I don't know. When I woke up again, I was already in the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom."
"I only have some memories of the past, but they are incomplete."
"I also tried to inquire about the past, and thought about returning to the human world, but when I tried to inquire, I received a serious warning."
Nan Pluto sighed with regret: "I can't go back."
Jiang Feng asked again: "Then do you still consider yourself a human race?"
Nan Pluto nodded: "Of course, this is a fact that cannot be changed."
Jiang Feng was silent.
Although Nan Pluto's soul and physical body are not completely consistent, the appearance of the soul is consistent with the physical body, which is enough to confirm that he and this body are inextricably linked.
This is a reborn soul!
In other words, his dead biological father was reborn, but lost part of his memory.
To be honest, he still has a hard time accepting it.
His biological father Jiang Li actually appeared in front of him in this way.
Moreover, can the person in front of me still be considered Jiang Li?
Jiang Feng himself couldn't explain clearly.
Even if he denies it verbally, some things cannot be changed.
